summary: SEQUENCING - liver: qualifying public sets exist. The strongest is PRJNA762641 (Zhejiang Univ.): 33 HCC + 33 paired adjacent liver, WGBS 2x150, ~30x, 4.36 TB. Next are PRJNA984754 (12+12, 2x100, 0.70 TB); GSE70090 (Feinberg/SYSU, 4+4, 2x100, 0.55 TB BS-only); GSE284332 (4+4 fluke-HCC, 2x150, 0.24 TB WGBS-only); PRJNA1103867 (3+3); GSE79799 (3+3, short reads); and ENCODE HAIB WGBS HepG2 vs one liver donor. SEQUENCING - lung: thin. No public set has >=5 deep pairs. Best are GSE70090 (3+3, 2x100, ~25-40x, 0.47 TB) and GSE79799 (3+3, under 100 bp per mate). Then ENCODE HAIB WGBS A549 (2 reps) vs 2 lung donors (2x151): same lab as the RRBS already read, but a different assay. PRJNA649023 has 5+5 matched but only ~4-6x. GSE316309 (27 NSCLC, 3 normal lung) has controlled FASTQ and only .mhap per-read haplotype files public. ARRAYS: lung - GSE235414 (EPIC, 65 pairs, 16 same-slide), GSE158422 (EPIC LUSC, 37 pairs, 29 same-slide), GSE94785 (450K, 28 pairs, all same-slide), GSE83842 (12 pairs, all same-slide). Liver - GSE136319 (47 pairs), GSE89852 (37), GSE136380 (23 EPIC) and GSE77269 (20): IDAT names carry no Sentrix ID, so slide pairing cannot be checked without opening IDAT headers. GSE157341 has 23 pairs but only 4 on the same slide. TCGA open 450K IDATs (GDC, data release 46): LIHC 50 T+N cases, LUAD 29, LUSC 40; GDC file names carry no Sentrix ID. Allowed with disclosure only. Full table: liver_lung_fingerprint_candidates.json (artifact version 30243f74-cc7f-444f-a8d6-61a1de19c6fe).
